instruction: Please enable the layer boundary display in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling layer boundary display in GIMP. Uses existing check_config_status metric to verify show-layer-boundary setting in sessionrc config file. Equivalent difficulty - single view preference change.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GIMP sessionrc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/sessionrc
Metric check_config_status correctly parses config file and checks for show-layer-boundary=yes setting
Postconfig is essential and correctly implemented - Ctrl+Q quits GIMP which triggers saving settings to config file
Expected value 'show-layer-boundary: yes' is semantically correct for enabling layer boundary display
Complete coverage - instruction has single requirement and evaluator checks exactly that setting
Data flow is correct: postconfig saves settings -> getter extracts config file -> metric verifies key-value pair
